controls.evidenceBasis: Reviewed single-dispatch transport, request guards, replay binding, ambient network guard and retained artifacts; not independent network telemetry.

limits: Retained diagnostics do not establish precisely why CPF issue coverage remained inadequate or which relevance rule admitted the SRS candidate.
The complete rejected request identity digest is not retained.
nextOfflineStep: Use retained A-paraphrase-2 response and saved captured evidence in a separate diagnostic harness; record issue scope, mapped-evidence rejection reasons, discovery request and candidate scores. Preserve frozen inputs and consumed namespace; do not widen inventory merely to suppress the failure.
validation: Read-only outcome review; no files changed by reviewer, no network calls or full suites rerun.
